invariant_argument: The fixed public surface obtains p(4), 5!, canonical prime-5 bundle count, Fano lines and AG(2,3) lines from the actual separately reviewed providers. These seven review documents, all nine production sources and both manifests are pinned. Provider outputs 5,120,6,7,12 are exact and fit both u64 and the compiled usize.

Errors are typed SurfaceError records. The source preserves the first failing stage, mapping provider errors to finite input diagnostics rather than continuing with defaults. The checked BigUint-to-u64 conversions admit exactly the fixed expected values and reject other representable or oversized outputs. Current fixed pure providers cannot enter those defensive failure branches, which remain reviewed rather than falsely covered by injected tests.

Private finish_surface trusts its two scalar arguments and joins three more fixed providers; it does not validate those scalar arguments itself. Only the preceding private checks supply them on the public path. Direct fixture calls with arbitrary u64 values confirm the weaker assembler contract. Public report fields and derived clones are freely editable; no type-level authenticity or general theorem follows from their names.

Fano linearity is recomputed using the reviewed pair predicate before its line count is reported. AG(2,3) uses the exact prime-order producer and explicitly checks twelve lines. Canonical prime-five MUB configuration uses the admitted operator-bundle producer and checks six bundles. This does not construct eigenvectors or classify dimensions.

The entry points call each fixed producer once in a fixed order. Wrapper/assembler code has no loop or recursion and introduces no redundant inner allocations. Provider allocations are bounded by fixed n=4,5, p=3,5 and seven-point Fano inputs under the provider contracts. Error formatting allocates only on failure. Successful returned records own their fields and no partial report escapes an error.

The native controls compare the assembled report to independently listed partitions and factorial/pair-count formulas; they also test all wrong scalar witnesses including u64::MAX, shared exports, cloned ownership and forged raw reports. Complete source mutation campaigns challenge false refusal and corruption of every exported field or provider check. Every designated fault is detected; mutation outcomes are literal, not inferred from test annotations.

proof_correspondence.fano_pair_count: Independent double-counting arithmetic gives seven triple lines on seven points.
proof_correspondence.affine_pair_count: Independent pair-incidence arithmetic gives twelve length-three lines on nine points.
